query: 环境策略与政策声明 环境策略与政策声明 衡量企业环境战略、政策承诺及治理机制完整性。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：具备系统的环境政策，涵盖全价值链边界；设定了科学的短期与中长期环境目标；明确了董事会及高管层的专项职责，且披露了明确的政策审议与修订频率。 • 1分（合格）：发布了正式的环境政策声明，包含基础的管理目标和职责分配，但在政策边界描述、目标的科学性或董事会实质性参与方面披露不足。 • 0分（不合格）：无正式环境政策披露，或仅有碎片化的环保措施描述。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：环境政策覆盖 >80% 的业务单元、子公司、生产基地及核心经营地区。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅适用于集团总部/部分区域，或未说明政策在全集团的推行范围。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 环境政策 环境策略 环境管理体系 政策边界 董事会环境监督 政策审议频率 集团环境政策 ISO 14001 EMS environmental policy environmental strategy environmental management system policy boundary board oversight of environment policy review frequency group-wide environmental policy ISO 14001 EMS 企业是否发布正式环境政策或策略声明？ 政策边界是否覆盖全价值链或主要业务？ 是否设定短期与中长期环境目标？ 董事会或高管的环境职责如何规定？ 政策审议与修订频率是什么？ 政策覆盖哪些业务单元或地区？

During the Reporting Period, we revised our documents including Emergency Plans for Environmental Incidents and Risk Evaluation Report to ensure operational compliance. ENVIRONMENTAL RESPONSIBILITY

[Content]
While optimizing the Group's internal management system, we continuously work on certification of environmental management systems. During the Reporting Period, our plants in China, Turkey, Germany, Czech Republic and Mexico have already passed and obtained the ISO 14001 Environmental Management System Certification, accounting for approximately 58% of the total number of plants. During the Reporting Period, we revised our documents including Emergency Plans for Environmental Incidents and Risk Evaluation Report to ensure operational compliance. In addition, the Group conducted trainings and drills based on the emergency plans to implement institutional documents while enhancing environmental protection awareness of employees.

results.section: STATEMENT OF THE BOARD / RESPONSIBILITY OF THE BOARD
results.text: Impro Group actively and regularly communicates with internal and external stakeholders to identify and assess ESG materiality development issues as an important basis for the formulation of sustainability strategy. We discuss the materiality issues identified and acknowledge the materiality of the issues. We formulate our sustainability goal, strategy and management direction based on the materiality of the relevant issues, the carbon neutrality and emission peak strategy of the PRC government and the Group's environmentally friendly development philosophy. We pay attention to our peers' and international sustainability performance for active follow-up and regular review on the Group's sustainability-related work.

Impro Group actively and regularly communicates with internal and external stakeholders to identify and assess ESG materiality development issues as an important basis for the formulation of sustainability strategy. We formulate our sustainability goal, strategy and management direction based on the materiality of the relevant issues, the carbon neutrality and emission peak strategy of the PRC government and the Group's environmentally friendly development philosophy. We pay attention to our peers' and international sustainability performance for active follow-up and regular review on the Group's sustainability-related work.

[Content]
Impro Group attaches great importance to the risks and opportunities associated with global climate change and greatly supports the PRC to strive for achieving carbon neutralizing goal before 2060. When identifying risks and opportunities associated with climate, we make reference to the carbon reduction targets formulated by the PRC and consider the potential effects of the relevant policies on the industry and industrial development cycles. During the Reporting Period, the Board preliminarily analyzes measures in response to risks associated with climate change as below. The Board also plans to formulate long-term realizable quantitative environmental protection goals for the Group in 2022.

results.text: Impro Group also includes the performance of suppliers in environmental and social aspects into the scope of important evaluation. In the Supplier Code of Conduct, we clarify the standards based on environmental protection and employment. Suppliers are required to provide MSDS certification and test reports on all ingredients, and to fill in the Environmental Condition Survey Form and sign the Supplier Environmental Notification. As at the end of the Reporting Period, 110 suppliers have obtained ISO 14001 system certification. At the same time, we pay attention to the risk management of suppliers, refine supplier types, and strengthen the supplier access evaluation to avoid risks. During the pandemic, the Group tracked the information of the suppliers in the regions where the pandemic occurred and tried to avoid a concentration of suppliers from one region. In the case of suppliers with a single patent, the Group tried to avoid the ordering of goods in a single region, stabilize supply and reduce risks through communication.

results.text: We uphold green and low carbon emission as the principle of our operations. We have recorded improvement in various key performance indices of environmental protection in 2021, including a year-on-year decrease of 2.2% in total energy consumption per unit revenue and a year-on-year decrease of 1.9% in greenhouse gas emission per unit revenue. We have established and implemented annual environmental goals and management plans during the year to ensure continuous improvement of the environmental management system. The Group plans to set up long-term realizable targets of greenhouse gas emissions and energy consumption intensity in 2022. Determination and efforts of the Group in energy conservation have been recognized by professional institutions. The Group won the grand award of 'Excellent ESG Enterprise of 2020-2021' by Hong Kong Economic Times in 2021 and was granted green loan of a total of approximately HK$400 million by DBS Bank and Citibank for purchase of environmentally friendly and energy-efficient production equipment.

MESSAGE FROM OUR CHAIRMAN

[Content]
We uphold green and low carbon emission as the principle of our operations. We have recorded improvement in various key performance indices of environmental protection in 2021, including a year-on-year decrease of 2.2% in total energy consumption per unit revenue and a year-on-year decrease of 1.9% in greenhouse gas emission per unit revenue. We have established and implemented annual environmental goals and management plans during the year to ensure continuous improvement of the environmental management system. The Group plans to set up long-term realizable targets of greenhouse gas emissions and energy consumption intensity in 2022. Determination and efforts of the Group in energy conservation have been recognized by professional institutions. The Group won the grand award of 'Excellent ESG Enterprise of 2020-2021' by Hong Kong Economic Times in 2021 and was granted green loan of a total of approximately HK$400 million by DBS Bank and Citibank for purchase of environmentally friendly and energy-efficient production equipment.
